game_info.title: Babylon 5 RPG 2nd Edition Combat Rules
game_info.description: Combat and special rules from Babylon 5 RPG 2nd Edition (Mongoose Publishing)

dice_system.description: Babylon 5 RPG uses a d100 (percentile dice) system. Roll 2d10 (one tens die, one units die) and compare to the relevant skill or attribute.
dice_system.resolution: Roll under the skill/attribute value to succeed. Rolling 1-5 is an automatic success, rolling 96-00 is an automatic failure.
dice_system.margin_of_success: The difference between the skill value and the roll. Higher margin = better result.
dice_system.critical_success: Roll of 1-5, automatic success with bonus effects
dice_system.critical_failure: Roll of 96-00, automatic failure with complications

to_tough.description: Health, stamina, and resistance to damage.

telepathy_system.description: Telepathy is a core mechanic in Babylon 5. Telepaths can communicate mentally, sense emotions, and perform various psychic abilities.

pathfinder.description: Rare telepaths who can sense other sentient beings across vast distances. Used for tracking and locating individuals.
limitations: Cannot sense through lead or certain alloys
Cannot distinguish between similar emotional signatures

guardian.description: Telepaths trained to shield themselves and others from psychic intrusion. Minbari Guardians are the most famous.

standard_telepath.description: Common telepaths who can communicate mentally and perform basic psychic abilities.

communication.description: Telepaths can communicate mentally with other telepaths within range.
communication.range: Empowerment x 10 meters (base), extended with training
communication.mechanic: Roll Empowerment + Telepathy skill vs difficulty

telekinesis.description: Move objects with the mind. Requires high Empowerment and training.
telekinesis.mechanic: Roll Empowerment + Telekinesis skill vs difficulty

mind_shielding.description: Protect the mind from psychic intrusion and attacks.
mind_shielding.mechanic: Roll Empowerment + Mind Shielding skill vs attacker's Empowerment + Telepathy skill

psi_blast.description: Offensive psychic attack that damages the target's mind.
psi_blast.mechanic: Roll Empowerment + Psi Blast skill vs target's Empowerment + Mind Shielding skill
effects: Knock out the target (with high margin of success)
limitations: Requires line of sight or telepathic link
Can be blocked by mind shielding

space_combat.description: Space combat rules for starship engagements, including ship movement, weapons fire, and damage.

ship_movement.description: Ships move in three dimensions, with movement measured in kilometers per impulse.
ship_movement.impulses: Each turn is divided into 12 impulses. Ships move based on their speed rating.

maneuverability.description: Ships have maneuverability ratings that affect their ability to change direction and speed.

ratings.excellent: Fighters and small craft, very quick turning

pulse_lasers.description: Standard energy weapons used by most ships. Fire rapid pulses of energy.

photons.description: Projectile weapons that fire energy warheads. More powerful than pulse lasers but slower.
effects: Can be intercepted by point defense

point_defense.description: Close-range weapons designed to intercept incoming projectiles and fighters.
point_defense.damage: Low damage, high rate of fire

damage.description: Ship damage is tracked in terms of shield points and hull integrity.

shields.description: Energy barriers that protect the ship from weapons fire.
shields.mechanic: Shields absorb damage first. When shields are depleted, damage hits the hull.
shields.regeneration: Shields regenerate slowly over time if not under fire.

hull.description: The physical structure of the ship. Hull damage causes system failures and casualties.
hull.mechanic: Hull damage is tracked in terms of hull points. When hull points reach zero, the ship is destroyed.

combat_sequence.description: Space combat is resolved in a series of impulses, with each side taking turns to move and fire.

phases.name: Initiative
phases.description: Determine which side acts first each impulse.

phases.name: Movement
phases.description: Ships move based on their speed and maneuverability.

phases.name: Targeting
phases.description: Ships select targets and aim weapons.

phases.name: Firing
phases.description: Ships fire weapons at their targets.

phases.name: Resolution
phases.description: Damage is applied to shields and hull.

phases.name: Repair
phases.description: Ships can attempt to repair damage and regenerate shields.

influence_system.description: The Influence system tracks political standings and reputation with various factions. Higher influence grants access to resources, information, and allies.

earth_force.name: Earth Force
earth_force.description: The military arm of the Earth Alliance.

narn.name: Narn Regime
narn.description: The proud Narn people, scarred by Centauri occupation.

vorlons.name: Vorlons
vorlons.description: Ancient beings who guide younger races.

shadows.name: Shadows
shadows.description: Ancient beings who manipulate younger races through conflict.

gaining_influence.description: Influence is gained through actions that benefit the faction.
methods: Heroic actions that benefit the faction

losing_influence.description: Influence is lost through actions that harm the faction.

unknown.benefits: No special benefits, faction is unaware of the character

known.benefits: Basic access to faction resources, minor favors

trusted.benefits: Access to faction resources, significant favors, intelligence sharing

ally.benefits: Full access to faction resources, major favors, military support

hero.benefits: Unlimited access to faction resources, faction will go to great lengths to help

ground_combat.description: Ground combat rules for infantry and vehicle engagements.

combat_sequence.description: Ground combat is resolved in a series of rounds, with each character taking turns to act.

phases.name: Movement
phases.description: Characters move based on their speed.

phases.name: Actions
phases.description: Characters take actions (attack, defend, use skills, etc.).

phases.name: Resolution
phases.description: Damage is applied and effects are resolved.

pistols.description: Handheld energy weapons. Standard sidearm for most characters.

rifles.description: Shoulder-fired energy weapons. Standard primary weapon for most characters.

heavy_weapons.description: Large weapons that deal significant damage but are difficult to use.

damage.description: Damage is tracked in terms of hit points. When hit points reach zero, the character is incapacitated.
damage.hit_points: Based on To_Tough attribute + armor bonus

injuries.description: Severe damage can cause injuries that impair the character.
types: Wounded: -3 to all rolls, cannot take actions

vorlon_and_shadow_abilities.description: Unique abilities of the ancient races, Vorlons and Shadows.

vorlon_abilities.description: Vorlons possess advanced technology and abilities that far exceed those of younger races.
abilities: Manipulate reality on a limited scale
Travel through space without conventional means
limitations: Bound by the Great Conflict with the Shadows
Cannot directly interfere with younger races
Must work through proxies and subtle means

shadow_abilities.description: Shadows possess advanced technology and abilities that far exceed those of younger races.
abilities: Travel through space without conventional means
limitations: Bound by the Great Conflict with the Vorlons
Cannot directly interfere with younger races
Must work through proxies and subtle means
